correctness.rationale: Independent canonicalization under S5(row)×S5(column)⋊C2(transpose) generated 1,1,2,4,10 complete orbit types for 0–4 forbidden positions. Independent enumeration of ALL 12,650 four-cell forbidden subsets found ten orbit sizes 50,1200,800,100,1200,3600,600,900,3600,600; sums and class types match. A separate exact signed simplicial-chain Smith-style unit-pivot reduction was performed on all 18 orbit representatives. d1 and d2 matrices have only unit pivots; d3 leaves either zero residual or rank-one residual whose entries have gcd exactly 3 with all two-by-two minors zero; hence integral H2 = Z/3 outside two exceptions, four-star gives Z^8, full 2x2 rectangle Z^7. Additional independent F3/F5 rank checks distinguished the same torsion and Betti structure for every orbit. This is an exhaustive *finite* certificate, not extrapolation to larger deletion counts. Read actual source verify.py to verify unit operations and rank-minor logic.
